description: Run a sequence by the name list_sequences gives (seq_… or seq_my_…). Its steps run in order, as you, in this one call; the result reports each step. Pass dryRun: true to get the resolved plan without running anything. A sequence may change or delete data; list_sequences says which are read-only or destructive.

dryRun.description: Resolve and validate the steps, but run none

inputs.description: The sequence's inputs, as list_sequences describes them

sequence.description: Sequence name from list_sequences, e.g. seq_daily_briefing

name: run_sequence
title: Run Sequence
